title: OG.com seeks CFTC approval for single-stock perpetual futures
summary: OG.com, recently spun out of Crypto.com, joins Coinbase, Kalshi and Kraken parent Payward in seeking approval to bring perpetual futures to individual US stocks.

title: Ex-CFTC leader to leave Blockchain Association after CLARITY vote fails
summary: Former CFTC Commissioner Summer Mersinger joined the Blockchain Association in 2025 after resigning during her second term at the federal commodities regulator.

title: Tether says it had ‘limited’ exposure to bank linked to $84M US seizure
summary: US prosecutors alleged that a payments business illegally transferred hundreds of millions of dollars at the direction of EQIBank, where Tether holds some assets.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Former Hack VC partner Hsin-Ju Chuang’s death ruled a suicide
summary: The crypto executive and Dystopia Labs founder previously held senior roles at Stellar and Solana before joining venture capital firm Hack VC.

title: Bitget clarifies $388M in assets affected by security breach
summary: The Bitget breach announced on Thursday affected about $35 million more than previously reported, based on an analysis of assets on Zcash and TRON.

title: Strategy seeks shareholder approval for daily preferred stock dividends
summary: Strategy’s proposal would move STRC and its three other preferred stocks to daily dividend payments, following a similar move by Bitcoin treasury firm Strive.

title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street and crypto fight for the same turf
summary: Stablecoins and tokenized assets are pushing banks, exchanges and crypto companies into the same markets, from payments to stocks and ETFs.

title: Exchanges reporting crypto gains to IRS becomes tax nightmare
summary: The IRS can now see your crypto gains, but has no idea about the cost-basis. That’s proving to be a big headache for some cryptocurrency investors.

title: CoinMarketCap buys CoinGlass to expand crypto derivatives data
summary: CoinGlass will retain its brand and team, while its website, app, free tools, API and pricing will remain unchanged following the acquisition.
